disposition_reason: Primary survey of 100 wheat-based traditional sweets (ten types, ten samples each) from Lahore bakeries with min, max and mean concentrations of 13 elements in Table 2.

study.origin: prepared by bakeries in Lahore, Pakistan
study.method: HNO3/H2O2 hot-block digestion; FAAS for Mg, Ca, Mn, Fe, Cu, Zn; ICP-OES for Al, Cr, Co, Ni, As, Cd, Pb
study.lod_text: LOD (3 sigma/S) and LOQ (10 sigma/S) reported only in Supplementary Table S1 (not available)
study.qa: NIST SRM 2384 (baked chocolate) recoveries 98.1-102.3% (Table 1); Cd 0.072 vs 0.0734 mg/kg, Pb 0.036 vs 0.0357 mg/kg; Al, Cr, Ni, Co, As recoveries not tabulated
